description_en: Queries the information about instances of manually triggered workflows
description_zh: 调用GetManualDagInstances，获取手动执行的业务流程实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-manual-dag-instances --project-env PROD --project-name test_workspace --dag-id 7000001231241 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetManualDagInstances

parameters.help_en: The scheduling environment identifier in Operation Center, including PROD (production environment) and DEV (development environment)
parameters.help_zh: 运维中心的调度环境标识，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace to which the manually triggered workflow belongs. You can obtain the name on the Workspace Configuration page in the DataWorks console
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程所属的工作空间名称。您可以进入DataWorks管控台，在工作空间配置页面获取

parameters.help_en: The DAG instance ID for the manual workflow run. You can obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189728.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 触发手动业务流程运行的Dag实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189728.html接口获取
parameters.name: dag_id

NodeId.description_en: The internal node ID of the workflow

ParamValues.description_en: The parameter information of the instance

Status.description_en:
The status of the node instance. Valid values:
NOT_RUN: Not run.
WAIT_TIME: Waiting for the scheduled time (dueTime or cycleTime) to arrive.
WAIT_RESOURCE: Waiting for resources.
RUNNING: Running.
CHECKING: Data quality check in progress.
CHECKING_CONDITION: Branch condition check in progress.
FAILURE: Failed.
SUCCESS: Successful
Status.description_zh:
实例任务的状态，取值如下：
NOT_RUN（未运行）
WAIT_TIME（等待定时时间dueTime或cycleTime到来）
WAIT_RESOURCE（等待资源）
RUNNING（运行中）
CHECKING（下发给数据质量进行数据校检）
CHECKING_CONDITION（正在进行分支条件校检）
FAILURE（执行失败）
SUCCESS（执行成功）

TaskType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the node instance. Valid values:
NORMAL(0): Normal node. The node is scheduled on a regular basis.
MANUAL(1): Manually triggered node. The node is not scheduled on a regular basis.
PAUSE(2): Paused node. The node is scheduled on a regular basis, but is directly set to the failed state when scheduling starts.
SKIP(3): Dry-run node. The node is scheduled on a regular basis, but is directly set to the successful state when scheduling starts.
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4): Unselected node in a temporary workflow. This type of node exists only in temporary workflows and is directly set to the successful state when scheduling starts.
SKIP_CYCLE(5): Node that has not reached its scheduled week or month. The node is scheduled on a regular basis, but is directly set to the successful state when scheduling starts.
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6): Unselected downstream node. An upstream instance contains a branch (IF) node, but this downstream node is not selected by the branch node and is directly set to a dry-run node.
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7): Expired periodic instance generated in real time. This type of node is directly set to the successful state
TaskType.description_zh:
实例任务的调度类型，取值如下：
NORMAL(0)：正常调度任务。该任务被日常调度。
MANUAL(1)：手动任务。该任务不会被日常调度。
PAUSE(2)：暂停任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为失败状态。
SKIP(3)：空跑任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4)：临时工作流中未选择的任务，仅存在于临时工作流中，启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_CYCLE(5)：未到运行周期的周或月任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6)：上游实例中有分支（IF）节点，但是该下游节点未被分支节点选中，直接置为空跑任务。
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7)：实时生成的已经过期的周期实例，该类型的任务直接被置为成功状态
